afterImage.name: JW Water Holdings, LLC
afterImage.description: JW Water Holdings, LLC is a regulated water and wastewater utility platform serving more than 50,000 customers in Arizona. CVC DIF completed the acquisition of JW Water's ten-utility platform and eight Robson utilities through DIF Infrastructure VII in November 2024. Pima became a wholly owned JW Water subsidiary on November 20, 2024, and current company and Arizona Corporation Commission materials show the acquired utilities operating beneath the integrated JW Water platform. Public sources do not disclose CVC DIF's exact ownership percentage or a separate acquisition SPV. Later Pima and other utility consolidations are internal legal and regulatory reorganizations, not manager-level ownership transfers. No later sale, sponsor exit or signed pending manager-level transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.

milestones.event: Public utility materials state that Pima Utility began serving Arizona communities in 1972; Pima is retained here as a child-utility history item within JW Water.

CVC DIF stated that the combined Arizona utility platform would serve more than 50,000 customers; current JW materials present the integrated business as 18 legacy utility brands and 20 water and wastewater systems.
Pima Utility became a wholly owned subsidiary of JW Water Holdings, confirming that Pima is an underlying utility rather than a separate manager-level PortCo.
CVC DIF acquired JW Water and the eight-utility Robson portfolio through DIF Infrastructure VII, consolidating them as one manager-level Arizona utility platform.

The Arizona Corporation Commission approved an internal consolidation of Bensch Ranch, Pine Meadows and Verde Santa Fe utilities and identified JW Water Holdings as owner of those utilities and 15 others.
The Arizona Corporation Commission approved the internal consolidation of Quail Creek, Ridgeview and Lago Del Oro into JW Water Utility Company.
